text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day off, in a restaurant I entered for 
lunch, I spotted Victoire Pisa and Rose 
Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
How about it, Rose? Is there anything on 
the menu that catches your eye?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Ah, or rather, pretty much everything. 
Just when you think there's Hayashi rice, 
there's Omelet rice and Omelet Hayashi? 
Way too confusing...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Hm, Pisa's Trainer? Truth be told, I 
wanted to get used to dining in unfamiliar 
places. So I asked her to show me around, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"You don't need to be so tense; it's 
perfectly fine to just pick whatever 
catches your eye, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...You've got a point. In that case, the 
thing that stands out most is—definitely 
this.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Turkish cuisine, counted among the 
three great culinary traditions of the 
world. I wonder what kind of dish bearing 
that name will be served...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, it was several 
dishes served on a single plate. The 
beautiful name left quite an impression on 
me...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's a detailed explanation right 
here♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"A local delicacy originating from 
Nagasaki. A single-plate dish consisting 
of tonkatsu, pilaf, and pasta." My, is 
that so?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, while the question of why it's called 
'Turkish' in Nagasaki remains, does it not 
look exceptionally delicious?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's wonderful how popular dishes 
like tonkatsu, pilaf, and pasta come 
together on a single plate.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I've decided. I'll have the Turkish rice!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll have the same. Fufu, I can't 
wait for it to arrive.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, what was brought to the table a 
moment later was—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: What's this?! Th-This is...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What was served was a platter piled 
absurdly high, reaching all the way up to 
eye level.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Toruko Rice is served in such massive 
portions, isn't it...
choice_data_list:
No, I think this shop is just an 
exception...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
However, is it really okay to finish this 
much food? It's definitely going to affect 
my weight...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Still, leaving leftovers is a bit...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I imagine food left all alone on 
an empty plate... my heart just aches...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it looks like you can take leftovers 
home after all.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"Then I shall return home and treat Ruler 
and the others to some as well."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's do that. I'm so glad no one was 
left behind...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having enjoyed a moderate, delicious meal, 
the two headed home carrying heavily laden 
souvenir bags.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
You're right. It is our responsibility to 
face this plate head-on.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what kind of king would I be if I 
could not overcome a mountain like this? 
Let us go, Pisa.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Rose-san. Let's enjoy it delicious to 
the very last bite.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having steeled their resolve, the two of 
them finished the meal without leaving 
behind a single grain of rice.
